_about: Word lists check_page.py reads for CV-1 (banned_words), CV-2 (hedging_phrases) and CV-28 (vague_headings). Edit them here, not in Python, and keep references/linter-rules.md naming the same terms. A subject adds terms of its own with a prose_rules object of the same keys in packs/contracts/<subject>.json, used with check_page.py --subject <subject>. Terms are matched lowercase; a vague heading matches the whole heading text.
